author: Praxis I
title: Enriched Feature Fusion for CRI-Off
abstract: This experiment tests the "Enriched Feature Fusion" hypothesis for the CRI-Off task. It addresses the "feature entanglement" problem observed in prior models by providing the prediction head with three parallel feature streams: one from the holistic (concatenated) input, and two from clean, separated sgRNA and target inputs processed by a shared-weight backbone. The final head receives a concatenation of the holistic vector, the two clean vectors, and their Siamese interaction terms. This allows the model to learn the optimal fusion of both holistic and comparative signals, aiming for a new SOTA on the CRI-Off task while maintaining overall performance.

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from typing import Dict, Any, Sequence

# Using Seed 7 for direct comparison with my best Synergy Model run (ID 914)
BASE_SEED = 7

# --- Hyperparameters ---
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'peak_learning_rate': 0.001, 'total_train_steps': 200000, 'warmup_steps': 2000,
        'd_model': 256, 'dropout_rate': 0.1, 'kernel_size': 7,
        'dilations': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16], 'motif_kernel_size': 5,
        'head_intermediate_dim': 128, 'sgrna_len': 20
    }

# --- Optimizer ---
def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    hparams = _define_hyperparameters()
    lr_schedule = optax.warmup_cosine_decay_schedule(init_value=0.0, peak_value=hparams.get('peak_learning_rate', learning_rate), warmup_steps=hparams.get('warmup_steps'), decay_steps=hparams.get('total_train_steps'))
    return optax.chain(optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0), optax.adamw(learning_rate=lr_schedule, weight_decay=0.01))

# --- SOTA Components ---
class DSConvBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int; kernel_size: int; dilation: int; dropout_rate: float
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        residual = x; x = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        x = nn.Conv(self.d_model, (self.kernel_size,), feature_group_count=self.d_model, kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,))(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x); x = nn.Dense(self.d_model)(x)
        return residual + nn.Dropout(self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

class Backbone(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        x = nn.Dense(self.hparams['d_model'])(x)
        for d in self.hparams['dilations']:
            x = DSConvBlock(self.hparams['d_model'], self.hparams['kernel_size'], d, self.hparams['dropout_rate'])(x, deterministic)
        return x

# --- Main Model ---
class EnrichedFusionModel(nn.Module):
    hparams: Dict[str, Any]
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        task_type, d_output, dataset = self.hparams.get('task_type'), self.hparams.get('d_output'), self.hparams.get('dataset')

        if dataset == 'CRI-Off':
            # 1. Parallel Feature Extraction
            sgrna_len = self.hparams['sgrna_len']
            sgrna_x, target_x = x[:, :sgrna_len, :], x[:, sgrna_len:, :]
            
            encoder = Backbone(hparams=self.hparams, name="SharedBackbone")
            holistic_features = encoder(x, deterministic=deterministic)
            sgrna_features = encoder(sgrna_x, deterministic=deterministic)
            target_features = encoder(target_x, deterministic=deterministic)

            # 2. Pooling & Calibration
            holistic_pooled = jnp.concatenate([jnp.mean(holistic_features, 1), jnp.max(holistic_features, 1)], -1)
            sgrna_pooled = jnp.concatenate([jnp.mean(sgrna_features, 1), jnp.max(sgrna_features, 1)], -1)
            target_pooled = jnp.concatenate([jnp.mean(target_features, 1), jnp.max(target_features, 1)], -1)
            
            holistic_cal = holistic_pooled / (jnp.linalg.norm(holistic_pooled, -1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6)
            sgrna_cal = sgrna_pooled / (jnp.linalg.norm(sgrna_pooled, -1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6)
            target_cal = target_pooled / (jnp.linalg.norm(target_pooled, -1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6)
            
            # 3. Enrichment
            diff = jnp.abs(sgrna_cal - target_cal)
            prod = sgrna_cal * target_cal
            
            enriched_features = jnp.concatenate([holistic_cal, sgrna_cal, target_cal, diff, prod], axis=-1)

            # 4. Prediction
            head_output = nn.Sequential([nn.Dense(self.hparams['head_intermediate_dim']), nn.gelu, nn.Dropout(self.hparams['dropout_rate'], deterministic), nn.Dense(1)])(enriched_features)
            return head_output.squeeze(-1)

        else: # General Path (Standard SOTA Dual-Path)
            backbone = Backbone(hparams=self.hparams)(x, deterministic=deterministic)
            main_p = jnp.concatenate([jnp.mean(backbone, 1), jnp.max(backbone, 1)], -1)
            motif_p = jnp.max(nn.Conv(self.hparams['d_model'], (self.hparams['motif_kernel_size'],))(backbone), 1)
            fused = nn.LayerNorm()(jnp.concatenate([main_p, motif_p], -1))
            calibrated = fused / (jnp.linalg.norm(fused, -1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6) if 'regression' in task_type else fused
            head = nn.Sequential([nn.Dense(self.hparams['head_intermediate_dim']), nn.gelu, nn.Dropout(self.hparams['dropout_rate'], deterministic), nn.Dense(d_output)])
            output = head(calibrated)
            return output.squeeze(-1) if task_type == 'regression' else output

# --- Wrapper Logic ---
class NetworkWrapper:
    def __init__(self, m): self.module = m
    def init(self, r, d): return self.module.init({'params': r, 'dropout': jax.random.PRNGKey(0)}, d, deterministic=True)['params']
    def apply(self, p, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        return self.module.apply({'params': p}, x, deterministic=deterministic, rngs={'dropout': rng_key or jax.random.PRNGKey(0)})

def create_network(hparams):
    hparams.update({'task_type': hparams.get('task_type'), 'd_output': hparams.get('d_output'), 'dataset': hparams.get('dataset')})
    return NetworkWrapper(EnrichedFusionModel(hparams=hparams))
